chunks: And it was also narrated by Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ḥudhayfah ibn Manṣūr, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The month of Ramaḍān is thirty days; it never decreases.

key_terms.أَبَدًا: ever; expressing absolute continuity in the statement
key_terms.ثَلَاثُونَ: thirty; specifying the number of days
key_terms.شَهْرُ: month; the designated lunar month being discussed
key_terms.لَا يَنْقُصُ: does not decrease; indicating no reduction below the stated number
key_terms.يَوْمًا: days; the unit of the month’s duration

ai.seo_question: Does this hadith state that the month of Ramaḍān is always thirty days?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the month of Ramaḍān is thirty days and does not diminish. In context, it relates to rulings connected to the determination of the fasting month and its legal duration.
